greeting.text: You killed the thing on the summit. I was sent up here to do that, and it was winning. My name is Bram. I serve the king in Tolmere, and the Red Fleet has been over my city since dawn, so I would like to go home now, if you are going that way.

joins.text: Good. Then we go quickly, and I will explain on the way why a man in your armour is walking with a woman in white.

rest.text: I have rested for six hours under a beam. Ask me again.

with_you.text: Whatever is in front of us, I will be in front of it first. That is what I am for.
